facility.name: Little Treehouse Early Learning Center #4
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 5440 BABCOCK RD, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78240

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Three caregivers from different classes were unable to provide ages of children in their class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Through an investigation, it was determined that proper supervision was not practiced when a child was left unattended on the playground.   The child was returned indoors unharmed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The active play space had protruding railroad ties from a wooden barrier that posed a risk of injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The composite structure did not have the required six inches of loose-fill around the structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments: Through an investigation, it was determined that director's responsibilities were not being met when a staff member was placed in a classroom where they could not perform all job duties and meet the children's care requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments (26 TAC §746.1003(3))

occurrences.finding: Employees Discipline Own Children: It was determined in the investigation that a caregiver was using prohibited punishment to discipline their own child while being present during operating hours of the child care operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employees Discipline Own Children (26 TAC §746.2807)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: It was a determined during the investigation that a situation where a child was left unattended on the playground was not reported to CCR staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: An individual with a provisional background check was left in charge of a group of children.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when an additional caregiver was added to the group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: In a group with a specified age of 12-17 months, there was one caregiver with seven infants.   Noted: an additional caregiver was added to the group during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The fence surrounding the playground was not maintained and two children were able to elope.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: It was determined during the investigation process that a caregiver with a provisional background check was allowed to transport children without another caregiver present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: There were five children unsupervised in a room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: An individual with a provisional background check was obsered to be alone with children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing: During the investigation process, it was determined that children, of all ages, were being grouped together for two hours at a time from 6:00-8:00 AM and being grouped again in the afternoon from 5:30-6:30 PM.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing (26 TAC §746.1615)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: During the investigation process, it was determined that infants (0-17 months) were being combined with children greater than 18 months older than them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization: During the investigation process, it was determined that an incident report was not completed for an incident occurred while the child was in care and had to seek medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.701(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: During the investigation process it was determined that after being made aware that a child sought medical attention for an incident that occurred while the child was in care, that a report was not made to Child Care Regulation (CCR).
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: Carbon monoxide detectors were not tested in the year of 2023 and in January 2024.   Noted: this was corrected during inspection when the carbon monoxide detectors were tested and documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation did not have a documented fire drill for the months of November and December 2023. The operation also only had one Shelter in place drill docuemnted for 2023.   Noted: Moving forward the operation will make sure that all drills are documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The operation did not have an emergency prepardness plan for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: Fire extinguishers should be inspected by a designated staff member frequently, but minimally once a month. These inspections should be documented.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection when the fire extinguishers were inspected.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: There was not a current employee list posted.   Noted: This was correct during inspection when a current employee list was created and posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The operation did not have documented tests of the smoke detectors in 2023 and January 2024.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection when the smoke detectors were tested.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: One Staff file did not include the necessary employee affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Five of the ten Children's records reviewed did not include all necessary information for emergency contacts listed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Three of the ten children's files did not include updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: An infant was observed to be sleeping in a restrictive device while also being wrapped in a blanket.   Noted: This was corrected as inspection when the child was removed and placed in a play yard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The carpet in the infant space was observed to have mold.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: Children are being placed in a restrictive device (high chair) to discipline the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: Children in care are being given screen time as an activity for longer than one hour per day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: There was one child file out of the ten children files viewed that did not have an updated immunization record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: There was one child file out of the ten that were viewed that did not have the name, address, and phone number of the child's health care  physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: A lagre black trash bag full of garbage was observed in the school age outdoor playground while the children were playing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: It was determined that in December a caregiver forcefully pushed a child to the ground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: There was a piece of climbing equipment that did not have 6 inches of loose fill surrounding the structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: There was a tunnel that the children can climb through that was broken on top of the tunnel on the pre-K through School Age playground.     Note: The director quickly removed the tunnel out of the outdoor play space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: There was expired hydrogen peroxide in the first aid kits located in the center and on the transportation vehicle. The expiration date stated November 2020.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director bought some new hydrogen peroxide and placed them in the two first aid kits.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: The infant caregiver was observed using her phone while supervising a group of infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A three month old infant was observed sleeping in  a bouncer seat. According to the caregiver, the  infant had been asleep for 30 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: A three month old infant was observed in a bouncer seat without being strapped in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The floor in the 3 year old classroom was visibly  dirty with several area of dirt around the changing table and sink.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: It was determined that a caregiver had given a child their cell phone to watch videos to calm the child down during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined that a caregiver did not present good judgement when a hot tray was placed on a shelf accessible to children, as a result the child was burned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: It was determined that a caregiver was telling a child to kick themselves instead of kicking others in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(7))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The door to the indoor gym had a hole at the bottom of it. Weed prevention tarp on the toddler playground had come up through the loose-fill creating a tripping hazard. The fence on the school age playground is separating from the  building creating an approximately 11 inch gap which can become an entrapment hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: During the course of the investigation, it was determine that a school-age child around 8 years of age is allowed to help in the infant room making the oldest child in care more than 18 months older that the youngest child in the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Child must not go more than 3 hours: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that children are only provided one snack in the afternoon.  Children that stay later are not provided an additional snack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Child must not go more than 3 hours (26 TAC §746.3301(d))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation's annual fire inspection was not completed timely.  The last fire inspection was conducted on 06/11/2020.      Note: The operation applied for their annual fire inspection on 11/16/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: I observed 3 out of 10 children's records were missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked: The gate that leads to the front of the building from the playground were locked and keys were not easily accessible for caregivers in the event of an emergency evacuation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §746.4309)

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: A background check for two people no longer employed with the operation was not inactivated within seven days.    Note: This was corrected at inspection as the background check was inactivated during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))
